title: A few blue days
alt: Turquoise water meeting a palm-lined beach in the Andaman Islands
description: Ferry rides, quiet beaches, and clear-water afternoons. An island break made for slowing all the way down.
fullDescription: Spend a few days moving gently between the islands, with easy ferry connections, beach time, and optional water experiences. The route is designed to leave room for rest as well as adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrive by the sea
itinerary.text: Land in Port Blair and take a relaxed evening to settle in.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Havelock
itinerary.text: Travel to Havelock and spend the afternoon by the beach.

itinerary.title: Make the water your plan
itinerary.text: Choose a quiet beach day or discuss available snorkelling and diving experiences.

itinerary.title: A quieter island
itinerary.text: Move to Neil Island for a slower pace and a sunset walk along the shore.

itinerary.title: Until the next tide
itinerary.text: Return to Port Blair around your onward travel plans.
